description:
Introduce the core value types for constellation points, bit labels, normalization metadata, bit-channel identity/semantics, demap-method selection, and modem capabilities — the shared foundation that every downstream story in epic `d4851c3d` builds on.

This task is the first and most widely consumed leaf task under the modem core API story (`24144d1a`). Eight downstream issues depend on the exact type names and invariants established here: trait task `d36ae697`, builder task `3e3fe377`, reference-path story `51334873`, Gray-QAM fast-path story `52112411`, bit-channel analysis story `e2c0f65a`, simulation/channel refactor `92186a40`, legacy-surface migration `46ffe45a`, and DVB-T2 integration `003e4088`. A breaking change here forces renames across the epic, so the implementation plan front-loads every decision the downstream work needs.

## Scope

Ship the complete sealed `ModemSpec` type surface plus BPSK and Gray square-QAM presets (QPSK, 16-QAM, 64-QAM, 256-QAM) with bit-channel semantics populated, so later tasks can start immediately against stable names.

See the implementation plan for full detail:
**`dev/active/c87c5043-constellation-data-model-plan.md`** (linked as a design document on this issue).

## Design decisions (locked in 2026-04-13 interview)

- **Scalar:** generic `ModemSpec<S: ModemScalar>`, with `ModemScalar` sealed to `f32` and `f64`. `pub type DefaultScalar = f32`; presets default to `ModemSpec<f32>`.
- **LLR ordering:** MSB-first within a symbol, symbol-major across symbols.
- **Normalization:** post-normalized points stored directly; `Normalization` variant and scale factor retained on the spec.
- **Sealing:** `ModemSpec` is sealed (private fields, construction only via builders/presets). Public `ModemView<'a, S>` exposes both contiguous slices and per-item accessors.
- **Label storage:** `LabelWord { bits: u16, width: u8 }`; 16-bit headroom for research constellations, `bits_per_symbol` tracked separately on the spec.
- **Bit-channel semantics:** ship `BitChannelSemantics` on day one with `Opaque`, `SingleAxisPam`, `IAxisPam`, `QAxisPam` variants. Presets populate the semantic variants; arbitrary constellations (future builder) default to `Opaque`.
- **Demap method + capabilities:** `DemapMethod { ExactLogMap, MaxLog }` and `ModemCapabilities` live here so builders can reject mismatches at construction.
- **Errors:** invalid construction panics with a descriptive message. No `Result` / error enum on builders in this task.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] `crates/gf2-coding/src/modem/` exists with modules `scalar.rs`, `types.rs`, `spec.rs`, `view.rs`, `presets.rs` and is re-exported from `lib.rs`.
- [ ] `ModemScalar` is sealed, implemented for `f32` and `f64`; `DefaultScalar = f32`.
- [ ] `SymbolPoint<S>`, `LabelWord`, `BitChannelId`, `BitChannelSemantics`, `Normalization<S>`, `DemapMethod`, `ModemCapabilities` are all public and documented as specified in the plan §4.
- [ ] `ModemSpec<S>` is sealed: private fields, construction only via preset or (future) builder entry points; accessors return a `ModemView<'a, S>`.
- [ ] `ModemView<'a, S>` exposes both contiguous slices (`points()`, `labels()`, `bit_channels()`) and per-item accessors.
- [ ] Presets ship: `ModemSpec::bpsk()`, `ModemSpec::gray_square_qam(order)` for `order ∈ {2, 4, 16, 64, 256}`. Generic `*_with_scalar` variants for f64 workflows.
- [ ] Gray square-QAM presets match the DVB-T2 EN 302 755 Table 14 bit-to-cell ordering (MSB half = I-axis PAM bits, LSB half = Q-axis PAM bits; MSB is coarsest PAM level).
- [ ] Presets store post-normalized points with unit average symbol energy and the correct scale factor (`sqrt(3 / (2·(M − 1)))` for square QAM).
- [ ] Invariants from plan §5 are enforced at construction with descriptive panic messages.
- [ ] Test matrix from plan §6 is green: type tests, preset tests, invariant panic tests, view tests, proptest-driven bijection tests.
- [ ] `cargo test -p gf2-coding --release`, `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`, and `cargo test --doc` are all clean.

## Out of scope

- Batched mapper/demapper traits (`d36ae697`).
- General `custom_constellation(...)` public builder (`3e3fe377`; this task ships presets only).
- Any demapper math or backend implementation (`51334873`, `52112411`).
- Rewiring `channel.rs`, `modulation.rs`, `fading.rs` (`92186a40`, `46ffe45a`).
- Bit-channel analysis collectors (`e2c0f65a`).

## Notes

Read the full plan at `dev/active/c87c5043-constellation-data-model-plan.md` before starting implementation. The plan contains complete type signatures, the preset bit-ordering table, the invariant list with panic-message guidance, and the full test matrix.
title: Define constellation and labeling data model
